curation.notes: AFM-SMFS unfolding of the trimeric integral membrane enzyme diacylglycerol kinase (DGK) reconstituted in POPC, either deposited on mica or thiol-linked to gold, picked up site-specifically by DBCO–azide click chemistry to a PEG-azide-functionalized cantilever; combined with Upside and metadynamics MD simulations and packing-defect mutants. The ~42 pN/nm spring and ~106 nm/s velocity in the auto record are simulation parameters, not experimental.

entities.name: Diacylglycerol kinase (DGK), single-cysteine variants N3C-DGK / C122-DGK (cWT) and packing-defect mutants, reconstituted in POPC

evidence.snippet: The construct harbors a His6 tag at the N terminus for purification and one cysteine at either the N-terminal (N3C-DGK) or the C-terminal (C122-DGK) end for site-specific modification. All internal cysteines of DGK were mutated (C46A, C113A).

entities.name: PEG linker (silane-PEGn-azide on cantilever, MW 600 or 3400 Da; DBCO-PEG4/PEGn-maleimide on protein)

evidence.snippet: We then incubated the cantilevers in the toluene solution of silane-PEGn-azide (0.15 mg/mL) at 60 °C for 3 h. Two different lengths of PEG linkers were used (MW = 600 or 3400 Da).
purified cWT DGK or its variants were mixed with 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (POPC) micelles containing 50 mM POPC and 200 mM dodecylphosphocholine (DPC)
